mintAuthority.summary: Commission-operated role holders can mint native liabilities on seven EVM-compatible deployments, including Hedera, and through the Solana Token-2022 mint authority. UUPS upgraders can replace EVM issuance rules. Fireblocks HSM custody is disclosed, but full live membership and signing independence are not verified.

review.evidence: Fresh October 2 chain reads confirm MINTER_ROLE 0x83465b1bac70dc63c0d6b72e9f012af4a1e7138a, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE 0x5e3372f9a1c04e789ef86df9ec35f87e000bb15b and UPGRADER_ROLE 0x7f6cc8151ac948429911dab959d9e305501079ba at all seven pinned EVM-compatible deployments. Solana authority is read at finalized slot 452748113. Commission reserve rules mandate trust backing, but the ledger dashboard explicitly denies assurance of metrics outside signed reports. Neither Secure Mint deployment nor complete reserve-gated issuance was proved; do not credit the announced Chainlink Proof of Reserve integration as live or use historical LayerZero multisig thresholds for current keys.
unresolvedQuestions: Complete live role membership and role-administration closure remain unresolved.
HSM signing quorum, operator independence and recovery policies are not established.
A current signed TNF financial report and reserve-gated Secure Mint activation are not verified.
Solana program upgrade/recovery governance remains incomplete.
